```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# packages
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(httr, sf, dplyr, purrr, tidyverse, lubridate, stringr,
               tmap, readr, janitor,
               spatstat.geom, sparr, spatstat.core, spatstat.explore,
               mapview)

# set tmap default
tmap_mode("view")

# folders
data_folder <- "data/aspatial/acra"
rds_folder  <- "data/rds"
dir.create(rds_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# SSIC codes (choose 3 relevant ones!)
ssic_codes <- c(56111, 56102, 47210)

# date range
start_date <- as.Date("2024-01-01")
end_date   <- as.Date("2025-06-30")

# OneMap geocode API
onemap_url <- "https://developers.onemap.sg/commonapi/search"

# Safe GET wrapper
safe_get_json <- function(url, query, retries = 3, sleep = 0.25) {
  for (i in seq_len(retries)) {
    res <- tryCatch(httr::GET(url, query = query, timeout(10)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(res) && httr::status_code(res) == 200) {
      return(httr::content(res, as = "parsed", simplifyVector = TRUE))
    }
    Sys.sleep(sleep)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

```

### Tidying ACRA data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

file_list <- list.files(path = data_folder,
                        pattern = "^ACRA.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

if (length(file_list) == 0 && file.exists(file.path(rds_folder, "acra_data.rds"))) {
  acra_data <- read_rds(file.path(rds_folder, "acra_data.rds"))
} else {
  acra_data <- file_list %>% map_dfr(read_csv)
  write_rds(acra_data, file.path(rds_folder, "acra_data.rds"))
}

acra_clean <- acra_data %>%
  mutate(
    registration_incorporation_date = as.Date(registration_incorporation_date),
    postal_code = str_pad(as.character(postal_code), width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0")
  )

biz_sel <- acra_clean %>%
  filter(primary_ssic_code %in% ssic_codes,
         registration_incorporation_date >= start_date,
         registration_incorporation_date <= end_date) %>%
  mutate(
    date = registration_incorporation_date,
    YEAR = year(date),
    MONTH_NUM = month(date),
    MONTH_ABBR = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

cat("Total selected records:", nrow(biz_sel), "\n")
biz_sel %>% count(primary_ssic_code) %>% print()

write_rds(biz_sel, file.path(rds_folder, "biz_selected.rds"))

```

### Geocoding

```{r}
#| label: geocode

postcodes <- unique(biz_sel$postal_code)

geocode_one <- function(pc) {
  query <- list(searchVal = pc, returnGeom = "Y", getAddrDetails = "Y", pageNum = 1)
  json <- safe_get_json(onemap_url, query)
  Sys.sleep(0.15)
  
  if (!is.null(json) && length(json$results) > 0) {
    df <- as_tibble(json$results)
    df$input_postcode <- pc
    return(df)
  } else {
    return(tibble(input_postcode = pc, x = NA, y = NA,
                  POSTAL = pc, BUILDING = NA, ADDRESS = NA))
  }
}

test_postcodes <- head(postcodes, 100)   
found_df <- map_dfr(test_postcodes, geocode_one) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

# keep key columns
found_clean <- found_df %>%
  select(postal, x, y, building, address, input_postcode)

biz_loc <- biz_sel %>%
  left_join(found_clean, by = c("postal_code" = "postal"))

cat("Records with coordinates:", sum(!is.na(biz_loc$x)), "\n")

# save joined
write_rds(biz_loc, file.path(rds_folder, "biz_selected_with_geo.rds"))

biz_loc_clean <- biz_loc %>%
  filter(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y))

biz_sf <- st_as_sf(biz_loc_clean, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

biz_sf <- biz_sf %>% filter(!st_is_empty(.))
biz_sf <- st_transform(biz_sf, 3414)

summary(biz_sf)

print(biz_sf)

biz_sf <- st_transform(biz_sf, 3414)


write_rds(biz_sf, file.path(rds_folder, "biz_sf.rds"))

```

### Quick Exploratory Maps

```{r}
#| label: exploratory-maps
biz_sf_plot <- biz_sf %>% filter(!st_is_empty(.) & !st_is_na(geometry))

tm_shape(biz_sf) + tm_dots(size = 0.06,
                           popup.vars = c("entity_name", "date", "primary_ssic_code"))

tm_shape(biz_sf) + tm_dots(size = 0.06) +
  tm_facets(by = "primary_ssic_code")

ggplot(biz_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
       aes(x = MONTH_ABBR, fill = as.factor(primary_ssic_code))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Month (2024-01 to 2025-06)", fill = "SSIC")

```

### KDE per SSIC

```{r}
#| label: kde

all_bbox <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(biz_sf))
W <- as.owin(st_buffer(all_bbox, dist = 1000))  # 1km buffer

kde_list <- list()
for (code in unique(biz_sf$primary_ssic_code)) {
  dat_sub <- biz_sf %>% filter(primary_ssic_code == code)
  if (nrow(dat_sub) < 5) next
  ppp_sub <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(dat_sub), W = W)
  bw <- bw.diggle(ppp_sub)
  dens <- density(ppp_sub, sigma = bw, edge = TRUE)
  kde_list[[as.character(code)]] <- list(ppp = ppp_sub, bw = bw, dens = dens)
  plot(dens, main = paste("KDE for SSIC", code))
}

saveRDS(kde_list, file.path(rds_folder, "kde_list.rds"))


```

```{r}
#| label: st-kde

biz_sf <- biz_sf %>%
  mutate(month_index = (year(date) - year(start_date))*12 +
                      (month(date) - month(start_date)) + 1)

st_kde_list <- list()
for (code in unique(biz_sf$primary_ssic_code)) {
  dat_sub <- biz_sf %>% filter(primary_ssic_code == code)
  if (nrow(dat_sub) < 10) next
  ppp_sub <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(dat_sub), W = W, marks = dat_sub$month_index)
  st_kde <- spattemp.density(ppp_sub)
  st_kde_list[[as.character(code)]] <- st_kde
  plot(st_kde, 1, main = paste("Spatio-temporal KDE: SSIC", code, "slice 1"))
}

saveRDS(st_kde_list, file.path(rds_folder, "st_kde_list.rds"))

```

```{r}
#| label: ripley-k

k_results <- list()
for (code in unique(biz_sf$primary_ssic_code)) {
  dat_sub <- biz_sf %>% filter(primary_ssic_code == code)
  if (nrow(dat_sub) < 10) next
  ppp_sub <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(dat_sub), W = W)
  env <- envelope(ppp_sub, Kest, nsim = 99, rank = 1, global = TRUE)
  k_results[[as.character(code)]] <- env
  plot(env, main = paste("K-function with envelope: SSIC", code))
  pcf_sub <- pcf(ppp_sub, correction = "translation")
  plot(pcf_sub, main = paste("PCF: SSIC", code))
}

saveRDS(k_results, file.path(rds_folder, "k_results.rds"))

```

          "KDE_56102", "STKDE_56102", "Kfunc_56102",
          "KDE_47210", "STKDE_47210", "Kfunc_47210"),
  short_text = c(
    "KDE (56111): clusters concentrated around key dining districts, with higher density near central business areas...",
    "ST-KDE (56111): shows gradual growth in central areas from Jan 2024 to mid-2025...",
    "K-function (56111): clustering significant up to ~800m, suggesting agglomeration effects...",
    "KDE (56102): retail outlets cluster along residential town centers...",
    "ST-KDE (56102): temporal evolution reveals steady growth in suburban areas...",
    "K-function (56102): spatial dependence within ~500m, flattening after...",
    "KDE (47210): supermarkets dispersed but show hotspots around new estates...",
    "ST-KDE (47210): strong entry in late 2024, concentrated in northern regions...",
    "K-function (47210): weak clustering effect, approaching CSR beyond 1km..."
  )
)

write_rds(report_short, file.path(rds_folder, "short_reports.rds"))
